home.heroTitle: Learn your deen, step by step
home.heroText: Structured Islamic courses taught by approved teachers, at your own pace.
home.f1Text: Follow a course lesson by lesson and watch your progress grow.
home.f2Text: Every teacher is approved by an administrator before publishing.
home.f3Text: Lessons can include readings, documents, images and recitations.
home.f4Text: Study on your phone, tablet or computer, in left-to-right or right-to-left text.
home.popularText: The courses most learners have joined.
home.s1Text: Register as a student in less than a minute.
home.s2Text: Search or filter the catalog and open a course to see its lessons.
home.s3Text: Join the course and work through the lessons in order.
home.s4Text: Mark lessons complete and see your percentage in your dashboard.
home.readyText: Create an account and start your first course today.
